scientific_integrity: The proof reduces every iterate to an explicit map on the \(2\)-adic valuation while preserving the odd part. Quasi-injectivity before the target iterate follows from the fact that the square indicator has no eventual nonzero shift period; failure at the target iterate is witnessed by two explicit powers of two. Finite replay is used only as regression evidence.
scientific_limitations: The construction gives explicit functions \(\mathbb N\to\mathbb N\) of every finite exact quasi-injectivity order, but the functions are nonmultiplicative and the result does not classify exact-order behavior inside narrower natural classes of arithmetic functions.
title: Explicit quasi-injective functions of every finite exact order
